versions.changelog: Token验证修复：URL改为geo-api.yk-global.com/validate；新增本地缓存5分钟；get_user_tier()新增DATA_CLEANER_API_KEY环境变量验证

Initial release of multi-source-data-cleaner 1.0.0:

- Supports multi-format data parsing (Excel, CSV/TSV, JSON, clipboard text)
- Provides AI-powered field recognition (names, phone numbers, emails, IDs, etc.) with customizable mapping
- Cleans data via deduplication (exact & fuzzy), auto-completion, and standardizes field formats
- Enables advanced features in higher tiers: AI-based classification, rules-based tagging, multi-source merge, and data quality reporting
- Integrates with Feishu for multidimensional tables and automated documentation
- Command line and Python API interfaces available with clear error handling and tier-based feature gating
